speaker: josias_thwaite
text: A heat like this, and still you come. Sit.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Your usual place, then. I'll not talk through the lesson.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: For the dearth, and for a quiet town. That is the whole of the prayer I'll add.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A quiet town is enough to ask.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Dinner is pease. Come when the blessing is done, and not before.
